# In Season

> Seasonal fruits and vegetables by month and country.

In Season tells you which produce is in season this month in your country.
It covers 197 countries and 62 fruits and vegetables, with climate zones and
southern-hemisphere month shifts taken into account.

- Pick a month and switch between fruits and vegetables
- Choose any country (auto-detected from IP when available)
- Shareable URLs encode country and month (example: /?c=FR&m=7)
- No accounts, no analytics

## Sitemap

See the full sitemap at [SITEMAP_URL].

## Notes

Seasonality is approximate and varies by region, altitude, and growing method.
